title: Real Ontology Integration (code consolidation + data-blocked coverage)
summary: Phase 2 consolidated the ontology subsystem into one canonical, tested surface and fixed the broken imports. Phase 2b parsed real licensed UMLS/SNOMED/RxNorm. Phase 2b-fix enriched the maps (MRMAP + ICD-9->ICD-10 CUI bridge + RxNorm ingredient matching), reaching diagnosis 0.8006 and medication 0.7767 on MIMIC-IV (both targets met). Phase 2 is CLOSED (Status A). See artifacts/phase2b_fix/. (Historical fields below predate Phase 2b/2b-fix.)

details: src/ontology/__init__.py now exports the canonical surface (ClinicalRecord, OntologyIndex, OntologyEngine, rule classes, loader, distance) plus legacy fallback.
loader.py: 'from .rules import DemographicRule, MutualExclusionRule, RequiredCodesRule' -> 'from .rule_engine import ...'.
tests/test_ontology.py now collects and passes (was: ImportError cannot import name 'ClinicalRecord').

canonical_modules.records.py: ClinicalRecord, OntologyConcept, OntologyViolation, OntologyRuleResult (canonical data model).
canonical_modules.index.py: OntologyIndex + new get_ancestors/get_descendants/has_concept + crosswalk lookups (map_icd_to_snomed, map_drug_to_rxcui, get_rx_classes).
canonical_modules.loader.py: load_ontology_index / load_ontology_engine; now also loads icd9/icd10_to_snomed + drugname_to_rxcui crosswalks when present.
canonical_modules.distance.py: shortest_path_distance, ancestor_distance, neighborhood (deterministic, safe for unknown concepts).
canonical_modules.rules.py: LEGACY ICD-prefix compute_s_ont fallback, untouched and clearly labelled as fallback.

ontology_assets.note: All ontologies/* directories contain only .gitkeep. Parsers exist (scripts/parse_snomed.py, src/preprocessing/build_umls_maps.py, scripts/parse_rxnorm.py, src/preprocessing/build_rxnorm_maps.py) but have never been run because licensed UMLS/SNOMED/RxNorm sources are not present.

coverage.detail: see artifacts/phase2b_fix/ (MRMAP + ICD-9 bridge + RxNorm ingredient matching)

reason_anomaly_v2_blocked: RESOLVED: real ontology maps + engine available; Phase 2 closed (Status A).
next_step: Phase 1b — implement ontology-backed anomaly-v2 injectors using the real engine + maps.
